missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Успех' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'был'. 'Его' marks possession, and 'полным' is an instrumental predicate adjective after 'был'.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Успех' is inanimate masculine, so its accusative equals the nominative as the object of 'отпраздновала'. 'Большой' is the agreeing masculine adjective.
Strategic focus: Genitive after verb. 'Успеха' is the genitive governed by 'желать', which takes a genitive object. 'Тебе' is the dative recipient of the wish.
Strategic focus: Dative after verb. 'Успеху' is the dative governed by 'радоваться', which takes a dative object. 'Своему' agrees in the masculine dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after adjective. 'Успехом' is the instrumental required by 'восхищены'. 'Его' marks whose success draws admiration.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Об успехе' uses the prepositional 'успехе' after 'о' to express the topic. 'Его' marks whose success is discussed.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of manner. 'С успехом' uses the instrumental 'успехом' after 'с' to describe how the concert went. 'Большим' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Успеха' is the genitive required by 'нет'. 'Без труда' uses the genitive too, forming a proverb about effort and reward.

missions.phrase: Её первые успехи очень радуют родителей.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Успехи' is the nominative plural subject of 'радуют'. 'Первые' agrees in the plural, and 'родителей' is the animate accusative plural object.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Успехи' is the inanimate accusative plural, equal to the nominative plural, as the object of 'отметил'. 'Наши' agrees in the plural.
